description: This file defines the EntityJoinOperator class, which implements join operators (like AND/OR) for building SQL conditions in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for combining conditions, generating SQL snippets, evaluating conditions against entities and data maps, and validation.

classes.name: EntityJoinOperator
classes.description: Represents a join operator (AND/OR) for combining multiple entity conditions in SQL queries, supporting SQL string generation, condition evaluation, and validation within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Builds a SQL string with join conditions (AND/OR) for a list of conditions.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Creates an immutable (frozen) version of the entity condition or subconditions.

methods.name: entityMatches
methods.description: Evaluates whether an entity matches the combined conditions based on join logic and short-circuit rules.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Evaluates whether a data map matches the combined conditions based on join logic.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Overloaded methods for evaluating conditions against entities or maps, returning Boolean results.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the condition(s) are empty (i.e., have no criteria).

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Validates that the conditions are well-formed against the data model before SQL generation.
